name: BeModelDeviceUseStatement
title: DeviceUseStatement Logical Model
description: Logical model for recording the use of a medical device by a patient

element.definition: Logical model for recording the use of a medical device by a patient
Unique ID of this device use registration, assigned by the system that creates the DeviceUseStatement
Reference to a request or plan on which this use is based, e.g. a ServiceRequest or prescription
Status of the registration (active, completed, entered-in-error, intended, stopped, on-hold)
The patient who uses the medical device
Extra information on which this registration is based, e.g. a prior Procedure or Observation
Description of how often or when the device is used, e.g. every night between 22:00 and 07:00
Date and time when the registration was entered
Who created the registration, e.g. a nurse recording the use
The device being used, e.g. reference to Device 'Insulin pump SN12345'
Reason why the device is used - can be a condition (problem), procedure or observation code
Reference to a clinical source for the reason, e.g. a diagnosis in a problem resource
The anatomical location where the device is used or implanted
